Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 1
Reason for Mistake: The Planner incorrectly extracted the birthplace as "Manila, Philippines" in its analysis of the WebSurfer results. The visible text from the search results explicitly states in the Encyclopedia.com snippet: "Born Sergio Osmeña, September 9, 1878, Cebu, Cebu, Captaincy General of the Philippines". Additionally, the Inquirer.net snippet confirms he was "born... in Cebu City". The Planner hallucinated the location as Manila, contradicting the primary evidence provided by the WebSurfer in the same step, leading to the wrong final answer.
